title: Cartzy Courier Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy

blocks.text: These Terms & Conditions govern the use of Cartzy by couriers and courier service providers who accept, transport, and deliver packages through the platform. By registering or accepting a delivery assignment, you agree to follow these terms.

items: Couriers must provide accurate and updated registration details and submit documents reasonably required for identity, vehicle, business, or service verification.
Cartzy may review, approve, restrict, or reject accounts when information is incomplete, inaccurate, or cannot be verified.
Couriers must accept only assignments they can reasonably complete.
Handle shipments with care and follow delivery instructions.
Protect package confidentiality and update shipment status accurately.
False pickup, transit, or delivery updates are prohibited.
At pickup, couriers should confirm shipment details and visible package condition.
Packages must not be opened, altered, substituted, or used for personal purposes.
Damage, mismatches, or concerns about prohibited items should be reported promptly.
Couriers must use appropriate and lawful transportation and follow delivery instructions where practical.
Make reasonable efforts to deliver within the estimated timeframe.
Delays, accidents, failed attempts, and other issues must be reported as soon as reasonably possible.
Couriers must keep tracking information current and provide valid proof of pickup or delivery when requested, such as an in-app confirmation or recipient acknowledgment.
Proof must be truthful and must not be fabricated.
Communication with customers, sellers, and logistics partners must be respectful and limited to legitimate delivery needs.
Couriers must not harass recipients, misuse contact details, request unauthorized payments, or share private order information with unrelated persons.
Applicable fees, commissions, payment schedules, and adjustments will be shown or communicated through Cartzy or the relevant service agreement.
Disputes involving fees, missing shipments, damage, or delivery claims should include accurate supporting information.
Reimbursements are subject to review and applicable policy.
Use Cartzy for unlawful activity or carry prohibited or undeclared items.
Tamper with or divert shipments, or falsify tracking records.
Misuse customer information, create fraudulent accounts, or interfere with the platform or another user's account.
Couriers are responsible for following applicable traffic, transport, consumer-protection, and other relevant laws and safety requirements.
Do not undertake a delivery when conditions make it unsafe or unlawful.
Report safety incidents promptly.
Cartzy may review complaints, delivery records, and supporting evidence to address suspected violations or service issues.
Depending on the circumstances, Cartzy may request an explanation, pause assignments, restrict features, or suspend or terminate an account, subject to applicable law and agreements.

blocks.text: Cartzy may update these terms when services, operations, or legal requirements change. Updated terms will be made available through the platform or another appropriate notice method. Continued use after an update takes effect indicates acceptance to the extent permitted by law.

This Privacy Policy explains how Cartzy may collect, use, store, and share personal information relating to couriers. Cartzy aims to handle personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy laws, including the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173), where applicable.
Depending on the service, Cartzy may collect:

items: Identity and contact details, account credentials, and verification documents.
Vehicle or service information and payout details.
Delivery history and support communications.
Device and technical data, as well as information needed to investigate disputes or maintain platform security.
Manage courier accounts and verify identity and eligibility.
Assign and coordinate deliveries, provide shipment tracking, and process payments.
Communicate updates, investigate complaints, and prevent fraud.
Improve platform performance and meet legal obligations.

blocks.text: Information may be shared when necessary with the relevant customer, seller, logistics provider, payment processor, technology provider, support personnel, or government authority with lawful authority. Sharing should be limited to information reasonably needed for the stated purpose.

items: When a delivery feature requires it, Cartzy may process location or route information to coordinate pickups, provide shipment updates, and support delivery verification or safety.
Location collection should be limited to the relevant service purpose and handled according to device permissions and applicable law.
Cartzy uses reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards intended to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or misuse.
Couriers should also protect passwords, devices, verification documents, and account access.

blocks.text: Personal information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including operational, dispute-resolution, security, and legal requirements. Information may then be securely deleted, anonymized, or otherwise disposed of when appropriate.

items: Subject to applicable law, couriers may request access to or correction of their personal information and may raise concerns about its processing.
Requests may require identity verification and may be limited where retention or processing is required by law.

blocks.text: Some Cartzy features may rely on third-party services, such as mapping, communications, hosting, or payment providers. Those providers may process information under their own terms and privacy notices.
Cartzy may revise this policy to reflect changes in its services, practices, or legal obligations. The latest version will be made available through the platform or another appropriate notice method.

For privacy questions, requests, or concerns, couriers may contact Cartzy through the official support or contact channel provided in the platform. Do not send passwords or unnecessary sensitive information.

agreement: I have read and understood the Cartzy Courier Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy. I agree to comply with the requirements described above and understand how my personal information may be processed for courier-related services.
